source: sequences/alignments/*.json — real MAFFT L-INS-i alignments of Ensembl 116 canonical proteins
what_this_is: PROTEIN alignments, residue by residue. Not a genome alignment: no nucleotide sequence is compared here, and the whole-genome difference (coding and non-coding) was never measured.
comparator: The flying fish compared against is Exocoetus volitans where Daane et al. 2021 has a row for the gene (6 of 9), and Hirundichthys speculiger otherwise (Xu et al. 2021) — both real flying fishes. Exocoetus is MISSING from kcnk5b, which is the one gene carrying our edit, so the edited locus cannot be shown against Exocoetus at all. The page says so rather than substituting silently.
four_colours: Columns are classed same / different / indel / NO DATA. The fourth exists because the Exocoetus rows are projections from Daane 2021 and cover only part of most proteins. An uncovered column is absence of evidence, not similarity and not difference.
engineered_row_is_derived: The winged zebrafish is not a third sequence anyone measured. It is the zebrafish row with one named substitution applied, and the build refuses to apply it unless the reference residue at that aligned column matches what the variant record says it should be.
headline: The winged zebrafish differs from its reference by 2 edited loci and 1 amino acid. In just the 37 causal-chain proteins with medaka orthologues, zebrafish and medaka (same class, different orders) differ by 7300 amino-acid substitutions (16054 positions counting indels) (median identity 79.2%); zebrafish and a bat (Myotis) by 10205 substitutions in 33 proteins (median 74.0%); zebrafish and human by 10765 substitutions in 37 proteins. A handful of edits against thousands of differences in a few dozen proteins, and these are only the coding differences in a tiny gene sample: the genome-wide difference, coding and non-coding, was not measured here and is necessarily larger.

natural_divergence.method: Biopython PairwiseAligner global, BLOSUM62, gap open -10, extend -0.5; identity = identical / aligned residue pairs; differences = mismatches + positions in indels
natural_divergence.caveat: median orthologue protein identity of zebrafish to each species ACROSS THE PROJECT CAUSAL-CHAIN GENES with Ensembl orthologues (not a genome-wide measurement)

genes.coordinate_system: Positions are 1-based residue numbers in each species' Ensembl release 116 canonical protein (protein_id given). Alignment columns are 1-based. Variant anchors: zebrafish positions refer to the zebrafish protein; lat4a F326L refers to the medaka protein as numbered by Daane 2021. Projected flying-fish rows are placed on medaka residues; residues inserted relative to medaka are dropped and uncovered positions are gaps, so those rows have no own-protein numbering.
